join.title: Create your account
join.offerApproval: Invitation for a {role} account. An administrator will approve your account before your first sign-in.
join.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, and . _ - between them. It is what you will type to sign in.
join.name: Display name
join.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A passphrase does very well.
join.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
join.network: The server does not answer. Check your connection and try again.
join.pending: Your account is created. An administrator must approve it: you can sign in afterwards.
join.stepExpired: Your account is created, but registering the passkey timed out. Sign in with your user name and password: the passkey will be asked again.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password changed. The sessions opened with the old one are closed: sign in with the new one.

links.copyByHand: Copying is not possible here: the link is selected, press Ctrl+C.
links.once: This link will not be shown again: copy it now and give it to the right person.

users.filter: Search a name or a user name
users.signedOut: The person is signed out everywhere at once, consoles included.
users.adminNeedsPasskey: At their next sign-in they will have to register a passkey: their password alone will no longer be enough.
users.rejectBody: The account {username} ({name}) is removed, and the user name is free again.
users.disableBody: {name} cannot sign in while the account stays disabled.
users.resetIntro: A single-use link will let {name} choose a new password.
users.resetEffect: The current password stays valid until the link is used; then every session of the account is closed.
users.resetShare: Give this link to {name}, and to nobody else.

clearBody.one: The passkey of {name} is cleared ({count}). An administrator registers a new one at their next sign-in.
clearBody.other: The {count} passkeys of {name} are cleared. An administrator registers a new one at their next sign-in.

invitations.intro: An invitation link lets someone create a local account. For one person, the account is active at once; for several, each account waits for your approval in the Users tab.
invitations.createIntro: The link is shown once, right after it is created.
invitations.usesHint: 1: the account is active at once. More: each account waits for your approval.
invitations.roleHint: An administrator registers a passkey before their first session.
invitations.noAdminHint: Administrator accounts need a passkey, which is only possible when Lab Console is served over https.
invitations.shareOne: Give this link to the person invited: it works once.

shareMany.other: This link is for {count} people; you will approve each account.

invitations.revokeBody: The link will stop working. Accounts already created with it do not change.

sso.intro: The identity provider (OpenID Connect) students and teachers sign in with. Changes apply at once, without a restart; open sessions are not touched. The server's administrator can always sign in.
sso.locked: The provider is set in the server's configuration (OIDC_ISSUER): it wins, this page is read-only.
sso.secretUnreadable: The saved client secret cannot be decrypted (APP_SECRET missing or changed): type it again.

fields.enabled: Sign-in through the identity provider enabled
fields.allowInsecure: Accept a plain-http issuer (test bench only, never with real accounts)
fields.callback: Callback URL to register at the provider

hints.issuer: Exactly as the provider states it, final slash included or not.
hints.clientSecret: Leave empty to keep the current secret. It is never shown again.
hints.scopes: Separated by spaces; openid is required.
hints.groupsClaim: A claim name or a dotted path, for example realm_access.roles.
hints.adminGroups: Separated by commas. Their members are administrators.
hints.allowedGroups: Empty: every account of the provider may come in. Otherwise only these groups (and the administrator groups).
hints.callback: To copy into the client's settings at the provider.

sso.secretKept: Secret saved (leave empty to keep it)
sso.issuerMismatch: Careful: the provider states the issuer {issuer}, which is not exactly the one typed. Copy it as it is.
sso.noPkce: The provider does not advertise PKCE (S256): signing in may fail.

reasons.insecure: The issuer must use https (except on localhost, or with the http option of a test bench).
reasons.forbidden_address: The server never contacts this address.
reasons.internal_address: The provider points to an internal address: refused.
reasons.redirect: The provider answers with a redirect, which is not followed.
reasons.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
reasons.too_large: The provider's answer is too large.
reasons.http_status: The provider answered with HTTP error {status}.
reasons.not_discovery: The answer is not an OpenID Connect discovery document.

me.title: My account
me.subtitle: Your identity, your password, your passkeys and your sessions
me.name: Display name
me.environmentNote: The server's administration account is changed in its configuration (npm run setup-admin), not here.
me.ssoNote: Your name comes from your identity provider: change it there.
me.passwordIntro: Your other sessions will be closed; this one stays open.
me.passkeysAdmin: As an administrator you sign in with a passkey. Keep at least one; adding a second one (another device) saves you from being locked out.
me.passkeysStudent: A passkey (fingerprint, device PIN, security key) signs you in with one click. Your password stays valid.
me.passkeysUnavailable: Passkeys are only offered when Lab Console is served over https.
me.removeBody: The passkey "{name}" will no longer sign you in.
me.endOthersBody: You will be signed out everywhere else; this session stays open.

errors.link_invalid: This link is not valid: it may have expired, been used or been withdrawn. Ask for a new one.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
errors.username_invalid: Invalid user name: 3 to 32 characters, letters, digits, and . _ - between them.
errors.username_unavailable: This user name is not available: choose another one.
errors.name_invalid: Give a name of 1 to 64 characters.
errors.password_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
errors.password_common: This password is too common: choose another one.
errors.password_like_username: The password must not contain the user name.
errors.wrong_password: The current password is not right.
errors.passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys need Lab Console to be served over https.
errors.step_expired: The sign-in timed out: start again with your user name and password.
errors.unknown: This account does not exist (any more).
errors.unknown_passkey: This passkey does not exist (any more).
errors.unknown_session: This session does not exist (any more).
errors.unknown_invitation: This invitation does not exist, or it is already withdrawn.
errors.last_admin: This is the last administrator: promote someone else first.
errors.last_passkey: An administrator signs in with a passkey: add another one before removing this one.
errors.too_many_passkeys: This account already has the most passkeys allowed ({max}).
errors.pending: Approve or reject this account first.
errors.not_pending: This account is not waiting for approval.
errors.not_local: This account signs in through the identity provider: nothing to change here.
errors.environment_admin: The server's administrator is changed in its configuration, not here.
errors.sso_locked: The provider is set in the server's configuration: this page is read-only.
errors.sso_invalid: Settings refused: correct the fields shown.
errors.sso_disabled: Enable and save the identity provider first.
errors.sso_unreachable: The identity provider cannot be reached.
errors.issuer_required: The issuer URL is required to enable sign-in.
errors.issuer_invalid: This is not a valid issuer URL (https://…, without ? or #).
errors.issuer_insecure: The issuer must use https (except localhost, or the http option of a test bench).
errors.auth_method_invalid: Unknown way of sending the secret.
errors.groups_claim_invalid: A claim name or a dotted path (letters, digits, . : / - _).
